title: SB 553 (2011-2012 Wisconsin Legislature, regular session): use of veterans identification cards as proof of identification for voting.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) s. 5.02 (6m) (g)
(quote) 5.02 (6m) (g) A veterans identification card issued by the veterans health administration of the U. S. department of veterans affairs.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): This bill permits a veterans identification card issued by the Veterans Health Administration of the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs to be used as proof of identification if the card contains the name of the person to whom it is issued and a photograph of the individual.
